description: Trigger evals for incident-triage: it fires on a concrete pasted failure (trace, error, red test, alert) that needs a fix-size call, while vague stalls, new features, finished fixes, review comments, and post-incident write-ups go to their own siblings.

should_trigger: CI just went red on main after the merge, nobody can land anything. Test is checkout.spec.ts > applies coupon, expected 90 got 100. Hotfix or slice?

prod is throwing 500s on /api/orders since the 14:10 deploy. Log says TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'currency') at buildInvoice (invoice.ts:88). Last deploy was the slice 03 merge. Triage this before I touch anything.

staging app crashes on launch, here's the stack: java.lang.NullPointerException at com.app.auth.TokenStore.load(TokenStore.kt:41). Started after we bumped the secure-storage lib yesterday. TASK_STATE.md says we're mid slice 04. Do I stop and replan or just patch it?
This one test keeps failing only on CI, passes locally: AssertionError in sync.test.ts, timeout after 5000ms. Env is ci, blocking my PR. How big is the fix?
our nightly job died with ECONNRESET talking to the payments sandbox, third night in a row. Full stderr pasted below. Is this our bug or theirs, and how do we handle it?

should_not_trigger.prompt: I keep going around in circles on this task. Same three questions every session, nothing is moving and I don't even know what is failing anymore.
Users keep filing it as a bug that the reports page cannot export to CSV. There is no error or stack trace, the export was simply never built. Set up the work for adding it.
The null check fix for the invoice crash is already in and tests pass. Write up the branch name, commit messages and PR description from the diff against main.
Greptile left 7 comments on PR #212 and the reviewer flagged a race in the retry loop. Turn all of that into a backlog we can work through.
The outage from last Tuesday is resolved and root cause is confirmed. Write the blameless writeup with timeline, impact against the error budget and action items.
